name: Ohio
coverage_scope: Statewide referral backbone; local program research is strongest in Morrow, Knox, Marion and Delaware.

name: Pennsylvania
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. County veterans and aging routes are mapped; four counties have dedicated local ombudsman contacts, with statewide routing elsewhere.
share_description: county veterans office contacts, matched local aging referrals and local or statewide ombudsman routes

name: New York
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. County, city and state veterans routes and local aging contacts are mapped; ombudsman routing is statewide.
share_description: county and city veterans referrals, matched local aging contacts and statewide ombudsman routing

name: Michigan
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. County or regional veterans and aging routes are mapped; Ionia uses statewide veterans routing and Wayne has two aging service areas. Ombudsman routing is statewide.
share_description: county and statewide veterans referrals, regional aging contacts with Wayne County city boundaries, and statewide ombudsman routing

name: Kentucky
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. Regional veterans representatives, aging, district ombudsmen and supported-living routes are mapped; veterans contacts are regional rather than separate county offices.
share_description: KDVA regional veterans representatives, matched aging contacts, district ombudsmen and Hart-Supported Living coordinators

name: Utah
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. Four veterans regions, 12 aging agencies and 11 ombudsman regions cover all 29 counties. County maps are separate; regional veterans numbers are not separate county offices.
share_description: regional veterans referrals, county-matched aging agencies and long-term-care ombudsmen
coverage_note: Veterans contacts serve four regions, rather than separate county offices. Aging agencies and ombudsmen use different county maps. Published sources reviewed October 14, 2026; not telephone-confirmed. Local provider, post and activity coverage is still being researched.

name: Indiana
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. Veterans contacts for all 92 counties, 15 aging agencies serving 16 areas and local or statewide long-term-care ombudsman routes. Published directory conflicts and Marion’s subcounty assignments are shown.
coverage_note: Official sources reviewed October 19, 2026. Union’s only published veterans contact is a role cell phone. For conflicting ombudsman listings, use statewide routing first; Marion has subcounty assignments. Published contacts are not telephone-confirmed. Local providers, equipment stock and available funding are not fully inventoried.
share_description: county veterans contacts, county-matched aging agencies and long-term-care ombudsman referrals

name: West Virginia
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. All 55 counties have veterans, aging and statewide long-term-care ombudsman routes. Thirteen veterans field offices cover 53 counties; Cabell and Wayne use statewide referrals. Four aging agencies cover every county.
coverage_note: Official published sources reviewed October 19, 2026. Eight ombudsman records rely on official search extracts and need further verification; start with statewide routing. Regional lists omit Doddridge and split Kanawha without a boundary. Fayette and Monroe have overlapping veterans assignments. Contacts are not telephone-confirmed; local providers and current openings are not fully inventoried.
share_description: state veterans referrals, county-matched aging agencies and statewide long-term-care ombudsman routing

name: Texas
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. All 254 counties have veterans, aging and long-term-care ombudsman routes. Twenty-eight aging agencies and 28 ombudsman regions use separate county maps; 11 counties use statewide veterans referrals.
coverage_note: Official publications reviewed October 19, 2026. Veterans phones come from 128 county-government publications, 115 TexVet state-university directory entries and 11 statewide fallbacks. Directory conflicts, role numbers and uncertain number types remain labeled; contacts are not telephone-confirmed. LaSalle aging coverage uses an official regional supplement. Local providers, equipment stock, funding and openings are not fully inventoried.
share_description: county or regional veterans contacts, county-matched aging agencies and long-term-care ombudsman referrals

name: Florida
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. All 67 counties have veterans service contacts, county-matched aging helplines and local long-term-care ombudsman routes. Miami-Dade has separate north and south ombudsman districts.
coverage_note: Florida's March 2026 veterans directory and Elder Affairs service-area publications were reviewed October 19, 2026. Eleven Area Agencies on Aging have one additional Palm Beach-specific helpline entry; 14 ombudsman districts are listed, with North/South Miami-Dade separated by Flagler Street. Contacts are not telephone-confirmed; local providers and funding are not exhaustively mapped.
share_description: county veterans service contacts, matched local aging agency helplines and local long-term-care ombudsman districts

name: California
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. All 58 counties have published veterans contacts or a clearly labeled statewide fallback, county-matched aging information lines and local long-term-care ombudsman jurisdiction maps with statewide hotline routing.
coverage_note: California county veterans offices come from CACVSO's published association directory; Alpine lacks a directory listing and Sierra's listed phone is blank, so both use a CalVet statewide fallback. California has 33 Area Agencies on Aging with 59 county/city contact entries, including separate Los Angeles County and City. The 34 ombudsman jurisdiction records deliberately give the statewide hotline, NOT a verified local phone. Published sources reviewed October 19, 2026; intake and service availability are not phone-confirmed.
share_description: county veterans referrals, county-specific Area Agency on Aging lines and long-term-care ombudsman routing
share_replacements: county veterans contacts and statewide fallback routes

name: Virginia
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. All 95 counties and 38 independent cities have veterans referrals, matched aging agencies and ombudsman routes. Independent cities stay separate from same-named counties.
coverage_note: Virginia has 25 aging agencies and 22 ombudsman regions, with separate service maps. The 13 statewide programs and local aging/ombudsman directories received full official-source review on October 20, 2026. Regional veterans assignments rely on official search text; the owner spot-checked Fairfax, Quantico and Tazewell page screenshots. Fairfax’s corrected page phone differs from older indexed text. Alexandria City and Falls Church City use statewide DVS routing. Central Virginia ombudsman calls use the explicitly instructed state-office line. Contacts are not telephone-confirmed.
share_description: veterans referrals, county- and independent-city-matched aging agencies and long-term-care ombudsmen

name: North Carolina
coverage_scope: Initial referral edition. All 100 counties have published county veterans offices or clearly labeled state regional contacts, plus matched aging agencies and regional long-term-care ombudsman routes.
coverage_note: 89 county veterans contacts and 11 assigned state regional contacts; most county phones come from the state’s 2024–2025 published directory. Current county pages correct Anson, Guilford and Mecklenburg numbers; Lincoln is added from its county website. Forsyth and unresolved Bertie use state regional offices. The 16 aging and 16 ombudsman regions use separate published contact routes. All 14 state programs were reviewed October 20, 2026. Fayetteville veterans home is closed for replacement, and new Independent Living purchased services are paused. Contacts are not telephone-confirmed; confirm intake before traveling.
share_description: published veterans contacts, county-matched aging agencies and regional long-term-care ombudsmen

name: Alabama

coverage_note: Starter edition. Every county uses the Alabama Department of Veterans Affairs and national locators until county research is added. Contacts reviewed 2026-11-02 on official websites; not telephone-confirmed.
share_description: the statewide veterans agency and national routes to local aging help, the long-term-care ombudsman and Medicare counseling
